summary: # CLO 2024 Academic Month: Innovation and Practice of Digital Technology in Higher Vocational Clothing Specialty Courses ## Introduction Hello everyone! I am very happy to be here today to learn and share with you the application of CLO 3D technology in clothing courses. Yesterday, I listened to the sharing of Mr. Gao and Mr. Luo. In fact, I feel that I have gained a lot. I usually take a course on clothing structure, and from Mr. Gao's sharing of 3D virtual technology and clothing structure courses, I really learned a lot and was deeply inspired. Maybe we will continue to improve in the future. ## Innovation and Practice in Digital Technology Next, I would like to talk about the innovation and practice of our school in digital technology within professional courses. In the latest McKinsey report, it was pointed out that by 2030, 800 million people will be replaced by machines. China will face the transformation of professions, marking the largest-scale change in employment. As a professional education worker, we must always pay attention to the new trends in industry development so that our education can keep up with the pace of the times. ## Application of Digital Technology in Clothing Education I will mainly talk about the application of digital technology in our school's clothing professional teaching process. ### Professional Accuracy The first aspect is professional accuracy, which is vital for the development of the industry. By 2035, key core technologies, especially digitalization, networkization, and intelligent development, are expected to make significant breakthroughs. The clothing industry will achieve new advances in new models and services such as design, plating, and customization. The emergence of ODM (Original Design Manufacturer) and product innovation has created a new model of soft and fast-reaction supply chains. The deep integration of digital technology with industries will become the standard service for industrial workers. ### Corporate Research and Teaching Activities To align with these developments, we have conducted numerous corporate research and teaching activities, leading to considerable thoughts and improvements in applying digital technology within our courses. Our school is located in Guangdong Province, a major clothing industry hub where the development of the clothing industry is rapid. However, there is a lack of intelligent and information-based talent promotion for corporate transformation and upgrades. ### Talent Demand in Guangdong New technology and manufacturing integration is a new model for the future. In Guangdong Province, management personnel involved in design and project management will need to recruit at least 8,000 new individuals annually. There are about seven clothing-related vocational schools and around 33 high-quality vocational schools in the province, producing approximately 400 graduates per year. On average, there may be about 100 students in each school, along with additional clothing graduates from various locations. However, this still does not meet the entire demand for skilled personnel, indicating a critical area of need for our industry. ## Overview of Our School's Clothing Academy Let me now talk about the basic situation of our school. Our clothing academy offers three majors: 1. Clothing Design and Supply Industry 2. Clothing and Garment Industry 3. Leather Design ### Specialization in Clothing Design and Supply The Clothing Design and Supply Industry major has three directions: engineering, marketing, and needlework. One of the unique features of our school is the large number of students in the clothing industry; we are only in the third grade of high school, yet the total number of students can reach 3,000, generating over 1,000 graduates per year. We are the largest clothing industry institution in Huanan, boasting 33 clothing design senior engineers and recognized as a brand demonstration major in Guangdong Province. ### Employment Statistics In recent years, our school's employment situation has been favorable. As of May 2023, we had about 1,006 graduates, with an impressive employment rate of 99.3%. Some students chose to pursue special courses and continue their education, while most entered the workforce. Approximately 90% of our graduates secured employment, demonstrating our commitment to providing high-quality opportunities. ## Enhancing Quality of Education To ensure high-quality employment for our students, our teachers are actively learning new techniques and methods to enhance clothing education and optimize industry development. ### Digital Rich Energy Creation Resources Next, I want to discuss the construction of digital rich energy creation resources. The rise of virtual imaging technology can quickly measure fabric, design and modify, implement and present, ensuring a smooth transition between 3D and 2D printing. This technology enables diverse design displays, including virtual embroidery. ### Digital Technology Integration Digital technology in clothing allows us to transition from digital platforms to style design, virtual clothing production, and finally connect to smart production. Our design-to-smart production process is fully digitalized. CLO 3D technology can complete the entire clothing process from construction to implementation via computer, significantly reducing the error rate of paper samples by shifting from 2D to 3D thinking. ### Advantages for Designers For designers, the transition from 2D to 3D enhances familiarity and communication with 3D printers, leading to more reasonable designs. CLO 3D technology fosters collaboration between designers, 3D printers, and sample workers, reducing the chances of errors. ### Virtual Fashion Ecosystem Similarly, many companies have adopted 3D virtual technology to achieve cloud-based fashion through virtual fashion. For example, China International Fashion Week represents a new ecosystem where virtual fashion shows and physical-virtual synchronized marketing have been transformed into one. ## Technology Integration in Teaching Our school adheres to the principles of technology integration and teaching innovation. We have established several centers: 1. Professional Virtual Fashion Training Center 2. Public Virtual Fashion Training Center 3. Virtual Fashion Experience Center 4. Virtual Fashion Creative Center ### Virtual Certification Systems We have introduced resources for cooperation in the development and application of virtual fashion. The first resource is a virtual certification system designed for the fashion industry, enabling our students to participate in practice fashion shows. The second resource is for virtual static exhibitions and shows, combining design skills with virtual displays. ## Museum and Project Teaching We have also developed a museum featuring clothing from various ethnic groups, including Yao and Zhuang, as well as Lingnan ethnic clothing. In our fashion history classes, students will engage in digital restoration projects, showcasing their excellent works in the museum. ## Graduation Design and Student Projects For graduation design, our school has approximately 1,000 graduates annually; thus, not every student is required to complete a graduation essay. Those in the orderly class are encouraged to adapt digital 3D clothing for their graduation design. This approach enhances their goals and learning outcomes. ### Student Achievements In recent competitions, our students have excelled, winning first prizes in national competitions and showcasing their designs in various categories. Our school’s teaching competition has seen us win top honors for two consecutive years, reflecting our commitment to integrating digital technology into our courses. ## Conclusion In conclusion, I would like to express my hope that our professional education work will continue to improve with the advancements in technology. Thank you, everyone. That's all for my sharing.
